body: 将上传白天客厅照片转成真实夜景。只改变照明和窗外时间：激活左边现有黄铜落地灯的暖光，窗外深蓝夜空，玻璃出现合理室内反射，柔和光衰减与阴影。锁定原几何、材质、物品、门窗、相机、构图，不新增任何灯具或物体。4:3。

## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

The original lamp glows warmly, the window turns dark blue, and all main objects and the camera remain fixed.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 47. [Source](https://github.com/qzh3722/awesome-nano-banana-spatial-design/blob/main/README.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
